rūpārūpabrahmaloka: [Rūpārūpabrahma+loka] (pu) CL=7 Rūpabhuṃi and Arūpabhuṃi, ((Rūpabhuṃi : sixteen levels in the world of Brahmas where they take corporeal forms) and (Arūpabhuṃi: four levels of existence in the realm of Brahmas inhabited by incorporeal beings)).
rūpārūpacetanā: [Rūpārūpa+cetanā] (thī) CL=7 Goodwill which is for Rūpāvacara (related to the realm of forms) and arūpāvacara (related to the formless realm).
rūpārūpadesanā: [Rūpārūpa+desanā] (thī) CL=7 Sermons (or) Teachings of the Lord Buddha which preaches about form (structure/appearance/body/physical form and visual form) and consciousness.
rūpārūpadhamma: [Rūpārūpa+dhamma] (pu) CL=7 The dhamma which concerns physical and mental
rūpārūpadhammapariggāhaka: [Rūpārūpadhamma+pariggāhaka] (ti) CL=7 Can be controlled/restrained Physical and mental dhamma.  rūpārūpadhammapariggāhaka(ti) [rūpārūpadhamma+pariggāha=rūpārūpadhammapariggāha=rūpārūpadhammapariggāha+ka. rūpārūpadhammapuñja: [Rūpārūpadhamma+puñja] (pu) CL=7 Aggregate of physical and mental dhamma.
rūpārūpadhammasamūha: [Rūpārūpadhamma+samūha] (pu) CL=7 All of aggregate of physical and mental dhamma.
rūpārūpadhammasantati: [Rūpārūpadhamma+santati] (thī) CL=7 Sequence of physical and mental dhamma.
rūpārūpadhātu: [Rūpārūpa+dhātu] (thī) CL=7 Rūpa Dhātu and Arūpa Dhātu, Rūpabhuṃi (sixteen level in the world of Brahmas where they take corporeal forms, Arūpabhuṃ (four levels of existence in the realm of Brahmas inhabited by incorporeal beings.
rūpārūpajhāna: [Rūpārūpa+jhāna] (na) CL=7 Rūpajhāna (has five kinds of Jhāna), Arūpajhāna (has four kinds of Jhāna).
rūpārūpajjhāna: [Rūpārūpa+jhāna] (na) CL=7 Rūpajhāna (has five stages of Jhāna : 1st Jhāna,2nd Jhāna, 3rd Jhāna, 4th Jhāna and 5th Jhāna) and Arūpajhāna (have four stages of Jhāna: Arkasarnissayatana , Vinyanissayatana Jhāna, Arkaisaryatana Jhāna ans Nayvasanyarbarsanyayatana Jhāna).
rūpārūpajīvita: [Rūpārūpa+jīvita] (na) CL=7 Rupajīvita Nāmajīvita (Physical life and mental/consciousness life).
rūpārūpajīvitindriya: [Rūpārūpa+jīvitindriya] (na) CL=7 Rupajīvita Nāmajīvitandre (physical life, mental/consciousness life and controlled senses).
rūpārūpakoṭṭhāsa: [Rūpārūpa+koṭṭhāsa] (pu) CL=7 A set of physical and consciousness.
rūpārūpamissaka: [Rūpārūpa+missaka] (ti) CL=7 Mixed with physical and consciousness/ mental.
rūpārūpanimitta: [Rūpa+arūpa+nimitta] (na) CL=7 The sign/omen of Rūpasamāpata and Arūpasamāpata.
rūpārūpapariccheda: [Rūpārūpa+pariccheda] (pu) CL=7 (1) Division of physical and consciousness/mental. (2) Should be divided/distinguished as physical and mental/consciousness.
rūpārūpapariggaha: [Rūpārūpa+pariggaha] (pu) CL=7 Restraining/controlling the dhamma of physical and consciousness/mental (distinguished by characteristics/sign).
rūpārūpapaṭibhāganimitta: [Rūpārūpa+paṭibhāganimitta] (na) CL=7 Paṭibhāganimita , sign of Rūpa(form) and Arūpa (formless).
rūpārūparāga: [Rūpārūpa+rāga] (pu) CL=7 Passion which attached on physical and mental/consciousness.
rūpārūpasammasana: [Rūpārūpa+sammasana] (na) CL=7 Concentrate and contemplate on physical and mental/consciousness, Contemplation of physical and consciousness.
rūpārūpasantati: [Rūpārūpa+santati] (thī) CL=7 Sequence of physical and mental/ consciousness.
rūpārūpataṇhā: [Rūpārūpa+taṇhā] (thī) CL=7 Rūpa taṇhā. (Lust which attached on physical form) and Arūpa-taṇhā. (Lust which attached on formless /incorporeal.

rūpārūpāvacarakamma: [Rūpārūpa+avacara+kamma] (na) CL=7 Rūpāvacarakamma (Kamma that gives birth in the material world; physical merit), Arūpāvacarakaṃma (Kamma that gives birth in incorporeal beings" realm).
rūpārūpāvacaravipāka: [Rūpārūpāvacara+vipāka] (pu,na) CL=7  The consequence of deeds/consequence which is Rūpāvacara (related to the realm of form) and  Arūpāvacara (related to the formless realm).
rūpārūpī: [Rūpārūpa+ī] (ti) CL=7 [Rūpī-arūpī] (1) It is being physical and mental/consciousness. (2) Rūpabrahmā (Sixteen levels in the world of Brahmas where they take corporeal forms) and Arūpabrahmā (Four levels of existence in the realm of Brahmas inhabited by incorporeal beings).
rūpārūpūpapattibhava: [Rūpārūpa+upapattibhava] (pu) CL=7 Rūpa upapattibhava and Arūpa upapattibhava. rūpāsā: [Rūpa+āsā] (thī) CL=7 Craving which longs for physical form /structure/visual form.
rūpāvabhāsana: [Rūpa+avabhāsana] (na) CL=7 Enlighten on physical form (or) Enlighten on  rūpārāma (enjoying sights/taking pleasure in forms).

rūpāvacarabhāvappatta: [Rūpāvacara+bhāva+patta] (ti) CL=7 Vitakavicāra  which can be reached to the state of Rūpāvacara. (Rūpāvacara means related to the realm of form). (Vitakavicāra means thinking (or) investigation).
rūpāvacarabhūmi: [Rūpāvacara+bhūmi] (thī) CL=7 Rūpāvacarabhuṃi (the realm of form), Rūpabhuṃi (Sixteen levels in the world of Brahmas where they take corporeal forms). See original.

rūpāvacaracatutthajjhāna: [Rūpāvacaracatuttha+jhāna] (na) CL=7 Rūpāvacara the fourth Jhāna. (Rūpāvacara means related to the realm of form) (Jhāna means stage of deep meditative calm).
rūpāvacaracatutthajjhānalābhī: [Rūpāvacaracatutthajjhāna+lābhī] (ti) CL=7 [Compare with Rūpajjhānalābhī (sī,ṭī,saca,2.140)].One who used to attain Rūpāvacara the fourth Jhāna.
rūpāvacaracatutthajjhānasamāpatti: [Rūpāvacaracatutthajjhāna+samāpatti] (thī) CL=7 Rūpāvacara fourth Jhāna samāpatti. (attainment of  Rūpāvacara Jhāna). (Rūpāvacara means related to the realm of form).
rūpāvacaracatutthajjhānika: [Rūpāvacaracatutthajjhāna+ika] (ti) CL=7 Attained Rūpāvacara fourth jhāna, Resolution/vow mind which is related to Rūpāvacara fourth Jhāna. (Rūpāvacara means related to the realm of form) (Jhāna means stage of deep meditative calm).
rūpāvacaracitta: [Rūpāvacara+citta] (na) CL=7 Rūpāvacara mind/consciousness, mind which is inline with the Rūpāvacarabhūmi. The mind which is opposite of rūpataṇhā (craving for material form).(Rūpāvacarabrahmabhuṃi means Sixteen levels in the world of Brahmas where they take corporeal forms).

rūpāvacaradesanā: [Rūpāvacara+desanā] (thī) CL=7 Rūpāvacara sermon, (sermon) which preaches Rūpāvacara dhamma. (Rūpāvacara means related to the realm of form).
rūpāvacaradeva: [Rūpāvacara+deva] (pu) CL=7 Brahman-being in sixteen levels in the world of Brahma where he takes corporeal form, Rūpāvacarabrahmā.
rūpāvacaradhamma: [Rūpāvacara+dhamma] (pu) CL=7 Rūpāvacara dhamma. (Rūpāvacara means related to the realm of form).
rūpāvacarajavana: [Rūpāvacara+javana] (na) CL=7 Rūpāvacara jo, Rūpāvacarajhāna Jo.  (Rūpāvacara means related to the realm of form)  (Jhāna means stage of deep meditative calm) ( Jo means surge of emotion).
rūpāvacarajhāna: [Rūpāvacara+jhāna] (na) CL=7 Rūpavacara Jhāna. See - Rūpajjhāna. (Rūpāvacara means related to the realm of form) (Jhāna means stage of deep meditative calm).
rūpāvacarajjhāna: [Rūpāvacara+jhāna] (na) CL=7 Rūpavacara jhāna. See - Rūpajjhāna. (Rūpāvacara means related to the realm of form) (Jhāna means stage of deep meditative calm).
rūpāvacarajjhānacakkhu: [Rūpāvacarajjhāna+cakkhu] (na) CL=9 The eye called the fourth material jhāna.

rūpāvacarajjhānalābhī: [Rūpāvacarajjhāna+lābhī] (ti) CL=7 One who has attained Rūpāvacara Jhāna. (Rūpāvacara means related to the realm of form) (Jhāna means stage of deep meditative calm).
rūpāvacarakamma: [Rūpāvacara+kamma] (na) CL=7 Kamma that gives birth (as rebirth-linking stage) in the  realm of form (corporeal being) and in the realm of formless (incorporeal beings), Rūpāvacara wholesome kamma.
rūpāvacarakiriya: [Rūpāvacara+kiriya] (thī,na) CL=7 Rūpāvacara Kriyā mind which happens  Rūpāvacara wholesome mind in noble person(such as Arahat"s mind) who attained Jhāna.

rūpāvacarakusalacetanā: [Rūpāvacarakusala+cetanā] (thī) CL=7 Rūpāvacara goodwill, goodwill related to Rūpāvacara merits. (rūpāvacara which is related to the realm of form (or) Being in the realm of form such as Brahmas in 16 levels).
rūpāvacarakusalajjhānasamāpatti: [Rūpāvacarakusalajjhāna+samāpatti] (thī) CL=7 Samāpata which is Rūpāvacarakusala Jhāna. rūpāvacarakusalavaṇṇanā: [Rūpāvacarakusala+vaṇṇanā] (thī) CL=7 Opening of Rūpāvacarakusala, Commentary expresses Rūpāvacarakusala. (Rūpāvacarakusala means wholesome deed which is related to the realm of form).
rūpāvacarakāya: [Rūpāvacara+kāya] (pu) CL=7 Rūpāvacarakāya, Conception stage which is result of form/Rūpa that is called Rūpakāya.
rūpāvacaralakkhaṇappatta: [Rūpāvacara+lakkhaṇa+patta] (ti) CL=7 Reached to the sign of Rūpāvacara. (Rūpāvacara means related to the realm of form).
rūpāvacaramagga: [Rūpāvacara+magga] (pu) CL=9 The path- cause called the material and immaterial jhānas, the cause called the material jhāna.
rūpāvacaraniddesa: [Rūpāvacara+niddesa] (pu) CL=7 A phrase that expresses Rūpāvacaratarāḥ by detail and elaborate version. (Rūpāvacaratarāḥ means dhamma which can be conception state in the realm of form).
rūpāvacarapaṭhamajjhāna: [Rūpāvacara+paṭhamajjhāna] (na) CL=7 The first step of deep meditation on the material world.

rūpāvacarapuññābhisaṅkhārapaccaya: [Rūpāvacarapuññābhisaṅkhāra+paccaya] (pu) CL=7 The cause which is Rūpāvacara puññābhisaṅkhāra. Rūpāvacara means related to the realm of form) (Puññābhisaṅkhāra means meritorious intention)
rūpāvacarasamādhi: [Rūpāvacara+samādhi] (pu) CL=7 Samādhi related to Rūpāvacara Jhāna, Rūpāvacarasamādhi. (Samādhi means stability of mind) (Rūpāvacara means related to the realm of form). rūpāvacarasamādhijjhāna: [Rūpāvacarasamādhi+jhāna] (na) CL=7 Rūpāvacarasamādhi Jhāna. (Rūpāvacarasamādhi means perfected peace of mind related to the realm of form) (Jhāna means state of deep meditative calm).
rūpāvacarasamāpatti: [Rūpāvacara+samāpatti] (thī) CL=7 Rūpāvacara samāpatti, well attain Rūpāvacara Jhāna. (Rūpāvacara means related to the realm of form) (Samāpata means meditation attainment) (Jhāna means state of deep meditative calm).

rūpāvacaravipassanupekkhā: [Rūpāvacara+vipassanupekkhā] (thī) CL=7 Vipassanupekkhā which meditate only on Rūpāvacara dhamma, Vipassanupekkhā concentrated on Rūpāvacara dhamma. (Rūpāvacara means related to the realm of form).
rūpāvacaravipāka: [Rūpāvacara+vipāka] (pu,na) CL=7 Rūpāvacara vipāka (result related to the realm of form), The effect of Rūpāvacara merits. (Rūpāvacara means related to the realm of form).
rūpāvacaraviññāṇa: [Rūpāvacara+viññāṇa] (na) CL=7 Rūpāvacara viññāña, Rūpāvacara mind/consciousness. (Rūpāvacara means related to the realm of form).

rūpāvacarārūpāvacaravipāka: [Rūpāvacara+arūpāvacara+vipāka] (pu,na) CL=7 Rūpāvacara vipāka and Arūpāvacara vipāka. (Rūpāvacara vipāka means result related to the realm of form) (Arūpāvacara vipāka means result related to the formless realm).
rūpāvasāna: [Rūpa+avasāna] (ti) CL=7 (Question) which has the end of Rūpa dhamma. (Rūpa means physical form; visual form).
rūpāvatāra: [Rūpa+avatāra] (pu) CL=7 [Rupāvatāra-saṃ.] It is inclusive in Rūpāvacara dhamma. (Rūpāvacara means related to the realm of form).

rūpāyatanavajja: [Rūpāyatana+vajja] (ti) CL=7 Should avoid Rūpāyatana (field of forms or realm of sights).
rūpāyatanavatthuka: [Rūpāyatana+vatthu+ka] (ti) CL=7 Has the located place/depended place which is only Rūpāyatana (field of forms or realm of sights).
rūpāyatanavinimutta: [Rūpāyatana+vinimutta] (ti) CL=7 Free from Rūpāyatana (field of forms or realm of sights).
rūpāyatanavisesa: [Rūpāyatana+visesa] (pu) CL=7 Special Rūpāyatana, Rūpāyatana which is special/strange.  (Rūpāyatana means field of forms or realm of sights).
rūpāyatta: [Rūpa+āyatta] (ti) CL=7 It is related to form.
rūpāyattavuttitā: [Rūpāyattā+vutti=rūpāyattavutti+tā] (thī) CL=7 As the state of relation with form, It is relation.
rūpī: [Rūpa+ī] (ti) CL=7 [Rūpa+ṇī. In Thī rūpinī. Rūpina-saṃ. Rūvi-prā, addhamāgadhī. Ruppanasīlo rūpī. Ruppanaṃ vā rūpaṃ, rūpasabhāvo, tadassa atthīti rūpī. Rūpamassa atthīti rūpī. Dī,ṭī,1.170. Sī,ṭī,saca,1.441. Ma,ṭī,3.220-1. Rūpajjhānaṃ rūpaṃ, tadassa atthīti rūpī. Ma,ṭṭha,3.176. Aṃ,ṭṭha,1.407. Aṃ,ṭṭha,3.245. Abhi,ṭṭha,1.235. Paṭisaṃ,ṭṭha,2.150] (1) have form (physical form/visual form). (2) have form of the Kasina object. (3) Have Karajarupa (form/matter caused by semen). (4) Has the nature of changing for the worse. (5) Used to change for the worse. (6) One who attains Rūpajhāna. (Rūpajhānalābhī person). (7) One who attains rūpakasiṇajjhāna (Physical knowledge It is a Jhana that arises by focusing on the material world). (8) Have form of the Kasina object which is object of sense. See original.
rūpībrahma: [Rūpī+brahma] (pu) CL=7 Brahman with corporeal form. Rūpabrahmā.
rūpībrahmaloka: [Rūpībrahma+loka] (pu) CL=7 Sixteen levels in the world of Brahmas where they take corporeal forms, Rūpabrahmā့ realm.
rūpīcatukka: [Rūpī+catukka] (na) CL=7 All of sum of four doctrines which believe that is, have form/material (physical form/visual form), Rūpīcatukka.
rūpīdevanikāya: [Rūpī+deva+nikāya] (pu) CL=7 Rūpāvacarabrahmā့ realm which is sixteen levels in the world of Brahmas where they take corporeal forms.
rūpīdhamma: [Rūpī+dhamma] (pu) CL=7 The law which has the nature of changing for the worse, Law of form/matter/material.
rūpīpada: [Rūpī+pada] (na) CL=7 Words which is Rūpī (material; physical; having form). See - Rūpīduka.
rūpīpādasañcara: [Rūpī+pāda+sañcara] (pu) CL=7 Wandering with the feet which are a beautiful (mysterious) figure.
rūpīyati: [Rūpa+ṇe+ya+te] (kamma,kri) CL=7 (1) It should be shown openly (or) It should be shown obvious. (2) It should be used a metaphor.
rūpūpaga: [Rūpa+upaga] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who clings to the physical world (Rūpabhuṃi). (2) One who comes close to the state of being with form. (3) Should be cling/come close to the state of Rūpakkhandhā (material aggregate; mass of matter). (Rūpabhuṃi means sixteen levels in the world of Brahmas where they take corporeal forms)
rūpūpahāra: [Rūpa+upahāra] (pu) CL=7 (1) Take the physical form. (2) One who takes and creates the gesture of ogre etc., (by self). (3) Taking the similar status. See - Rūpūpahārattha.
rūpūpahārattha: [Rūpūpahāra+attha] (ti) CL=7 Has meaning which is taking similar status as an example.
rūpūpajīvikā: [Rūpa+upajīvikā] (thī) CL=7 A woman who makes a living by her vision/body/physical form, Prostitute.
rūpūpajīvinī: [Rūpūpajīvi+inī] (thī) CL=7 [Rapena upajīvatīti rūpūpajīvinī. Dhāna,ṭī.233.] rūpūpajīvi - See.
rūpūpajīvī: [Rūpa+upajīvī] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī  rūpūpajīvinī.] Prostitute (female), One who makes a living with her body. See also - Rūpūpajīvikā.
rūpūpapatti: [Rūpa+upapatti] (thī) CL=7 [Rūpūpattiyāti ettha rūpabhavo rūpaṃ uttarapadalopena. Aṃ,ṭī,1.50. Mūlaṭī,1.64.] Being as the state of conception in the realm of forms (Rūpabhuṃi).
rūpūpasaṃhāra: [Rūpa+upasaṃhāra] (pu) CL=7  Taking similar status as an example. See also - Rūpūpahāra(2). (Rūpūpahāra means  providing a sight; arranging something to see; lit. bring a form near).
rūpūpaya: [Rūpa+upaya] (ti) CL=7 [Compare with Rūpūpāya]. Concentrate on Rūpakkhandhā (material aggregate; mass of matter) (by the power of passion and wrong believe. Rūpūpaya(ti) [rūpa+upaya] rūpupaya - See.
rūpūpāya: [Rūpa+upāya] (ti) CL=7 Rūpūpaya - See. Rūpūpāya(ti) [rūpa+upāya] Concentrated on Rūpakkhandhā ( material aggregate; mass of matter).
rūḷha: [Rūha+ta] (ti) CL=7 [Rūḍha-saṃ. Prā. Addhamāgadhī. Although it is  "rū" with Dīgha in all of three language such as Sakkata, In Pāḷi should be 'Rassa and Ruḷha' right Pāṭha to consider Saddā books such as Rū]. Ruḷha - See. ( Ruḷha means  healed; cured; lit. grown over)
rūḷhakacchāvana: [Rūḷha+kacchā+vana] (ti) CL=7 [Ayuttasamāsa.]  A place of curve beside the mountains which has a forest where many trees are growing (or)  a mountainous area where forests grow. Rūḷhakacchāvana.
rūḷhatiṇa: [Rūḷha+tiṇa] (ti) CL=7 Have grasses (lawn) where grasses are growing well.
rūḷhavana: [Rūḷha+vana] (ti) CL=7 There is a growing forest (or) There is a forest where many plants are growing well. Rūḷhakacchāvana - See. ( Rūḷhakacchāvana means a mountainous area where forests grow)
rūḷhavaṇa: [Rūḷha+vaṇa] (ti) CL=7 Have sore/wound which is healed nearly to be normal.
rūḷhī: [Rūha+ti] (thī) CL=7 [Rūha+ta+ī. Kāraṇamanapekkhitvā icchāmattena rūhiyati voharīyati saññīdabbe vā upacariyatīti rūḷhī.maṇimañcū,2.468.] Ruḷhī- See.
rūpanimittassādasayojanasayutta: [Rūpanimittassāda+saṃyojana+saṃyutta] (ti) CL=7 It is related/compared with attachment which is Rūpanimita (Rūpanimita means the sign that is the cause which is physical form/visual form).
rūpapasasaka: [Rūpa+pasaṃsaka] (ti) CL=7 Who praises the physical form/appearance.
rūpapaṭisavedī: [Rūpa+paṭisaṃvedī] (ti) CL=7 Used to enjoy on physical form/visual form.
rūpapaṭisayutta: [Rūpa+paṭisaṃyutta] (ti) CL=7 It is related/connected with physical form which should be developed/ prospered.
rūparāgappaṭisavedī: [Rūparāga+paṭisaṃvedī] (ti) CL=7 One who used to enjoy and pleasure on lust which attached on physical form/visual form.
rūpasamāpattianantara: [Rūpasamāpatti+anantaraṃ] (ti) CL=7 (Period) when it is on the other hand of Rūpāvacara-samāpata. (Rūpāvacara mean the dhamma which can be caught in a vicious circle of Rūpabhumi). (Samāpata means attainment stage of meditation).
rūpasasāra: [Rūpa+saṃsāra] (pu) CL=7 The circle of physical form/visual form of any living being, It is caught in a vicious circle of any living being who has physical form/structure.
rūpasayojana: [Rūparāga+saṃyojana] (na) CL=7 [Rāga-pudakye.] Rūparāga attachment on physical form/structure.
rūpasayojanagahaṇa: [Rūpasaṃyojana+gahaṇa] (na) CL=7 Taking a physical attachment (or) Taking the attachment which is attached on physical form/structure.
rūpasayojanātiga: [Rūpasaṃyojana+atiga=(ati+gamu+kvi).] (ti) CL=7 overcome Rūparāga (attached on physical form/structure/visual form).
rūpasayutta: [Rūpa+saññutta] (ti) CL=7 It is related/connected with physical form/visual form.
rūpiyasavohāra: [Rūpiya+saṃvohāra] (pu) CL=7 Trading and exchanging gold and silver (coin).
rūpiyasavohārasikkhāpada: [Rūpiyasaṃvohāra+sikkhāpada] (na) CL=7 Vinaya which prohibits due to trade and exchange gold and silver (coin).
rūpūpasahāra: [Rūpa+upasaṃhāra] (pu) CL=7  Taking similar status as an example. See also - Rūpūpahāra(2). (Rūpūpahāra means  providing a sight; arranging something to see; lit. bring a form near).
